name: chatgpt-use
title_zh: Plus 订阅当 Codex 用
tagline_zh: 不花 API 一分钱，不碰 Codex 计费。让 ChatGPT 网页版通过 MCP 读你本地文件、跑终端命令。
tagline_en: No API key, no Codex billing. Route coding tasks through your ChatGPT web plan via MCP—local files, terminal.
desc_en: Turn the user's ChatGPT web subscription (Plus/Pro) into a coding-agent backend — no API key, no Codex billing. Use when the user wants to delegate a question, plan, review, debug pass, or whole task to ChatGPT ("ask ChatGPT", "让 ChatGPT 看看/做", "second opinion from GPT"), route work through their paid web subscription instead of API tokens, expose local files/terminal to ChatGPT via its MCP connec
why_zh: 它把网页订阅的对话能力伪装成标准 MCP 服务，让任何支持 MCP 的 agent 都能调用。
why_en: It wraps your web subscription as a standard MCP server, so any MCP-aware agent can call ChatGPT. Your existing Plus plan.
limit_zh: 只认 ChatGPT 网页版 Plus/Pro 订阅，免费版或 Team 不适用；需保持浏览器登录态。
limit_en: Requires ChatGPT web Plus/Pro only—free/Team won't work. Needs an active browser session; relies on unofficial reverse-engineered endpoints that may.
title_en: Use Plus as Codex: MCP bridge, no API key
